abilities.name: Convoy Law
abilities.text: Once per round, when you reveal or accept a Contract, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0.

abilities.name: Old Oaths
abilities.text: Once per round, when you accept a route or escort Contract, record 1 Convoy Note.

abilities.name: Chain Signal
abilities.text: After you clear a movement or contract sector, leave 1 Convoy Note there. The next operative entering that sector gains +1 to their first non-battle test.

abilities.name: Fleet Memory
abilities.text: At the start of your turn, if scenario pressure is above 0, record 1 Convoy Note. Weakness: Convoy Notes cannot be spent on your own Grit battles.
